title: Fuji Electric Monitouch V-SFT Insecure Configuration Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate their privileges on vulnerable installations of Fuji Electric Monitouch V-SFT. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of Monitouch V-SFT. The software is installed with weak access controls on the executable files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of any user of the software.
